thread:
release-manager: Heads up — release window for v3.8 starts in ~30m. Canary publish to eu-ecr failed during mirror step with a provenance/attestation error. Logs show manifest uploaded but attestation absent.

ci-bot: CI job #2876 failed: exit code 1 — cosign attestation missing. Retry scheduled (auto-retry: off for attestation errors).

sam: I pulled the manifest — there's an extra annotation `org.redwood.build.id` that our mirror expects, but the attestor step didn't run.

maya: Confirmed. The builder ran but the attestation step errored out on the signer VM (timeout). If we retag and push without attestation, deploybot will block promotion.

deploy-bot: Promotion halted for `release-v3.8-canary` — blocked by provenance guard (policy: require cosign attestation).

ops-jen: Options: (1) re-run the build to generate attestation (adds ~6m), (2) pin canary to last-known-good digest and proceed with rollout, (3) manual override of deploybot (org policy restricts this to SRE lead).

release-manager: Prefer re-run, but change window ends in 45m. Suggest pinning canary to previous digest for now and re-run attestation in parallel. We should record this in the release notes as a temporary pin.

sre-luis: +1 to pin so downstream systems aren't blocked. After pin, run the smoke tests and then switch once attestation is present. We'll need a short postmortem for the attestor VM timeout.

sam: I'll open a quick PR to pin the canary image to `sha256:aa11bb22cc33dd44ee55ff66aa77bb88cc99ddeeff00112233445566778899aa` and update the release-notes draft.

ci-bot: Push attempt output: ```
$ ./scripts/push.sh eu release-v3.8
Pushing manifest... OK
cosign: error: attestation missing for manifest sha256:...
Exit 1
```

maya: Starting attestation rerun now — triggering build #2880 with attestor on standby (command: `gcloud builds submit --config=ci/cloudbuild-attest.yaml --substitutions=_TAG=release-v3.8`). ETA ~7m.

ops-jen: Reminder: manual `--no-verify` push to mirror is blocked for eu region until we get explicit SRE approval. Please don't do ad-hoc workarounds.

deploy-bot: Manual override currently disabled for org-wide provenance policy. Automated promotions will resume when attestation is present or a pin is merged.

release-manager: Plan: (a) Sam pins canary to previous digest now, (b) Maya completes attestation rerun, (c) Once cosign attestation shows up, we swap canary to new digest and update release-notes to reflect the brief pin and reason. I'll notify legal/compliance if the attestation delay impacts any customers. Who can confirm ETA on the pin PR merge?

sam: PR #4023 created to pin canary -> sha256:aa11bb22... — requesting quick review from @ops-jen and @sre-luis. ETA ~5m to merge if approvals come back.

maya: Build #2880 started. Attestation step shows "signer connected" — fingers crossed. ETA ~7m.

deploy-bot: Noted. Canary promotion will re-evaluate when PR is merged and attestation present on the registry.

sre-luis: After the switch, we'll run the standard smoke: `curl -sS -D - http://canary.redwood/api/health | grep UP` and a small QPS ramp to validate KV-cache behavior.

release-manager: Thanks team. Once sam confirms PR merged, I'll patch the release-notes with a short note about the temporary pin (attestation rerun in progress). Extending the change window by +15m to cover the re-run. :white_check_mark:
